# Tests

| Question | Expected answer |
|---|---|
| Do I need a harness for bouldering? | No; use the mats. |
| What do I need before rope climbing? | A belay check by staff. |
| Can I hire shoes? | Yes, at the desk. |
| Can my nine-year-old climb? | Yes, with a parent who passed the belay check. |
| Are climbing shoes required? | Yes, on the walls. |
| Can I climb ropes on my first visit? | Only after the belay check. |
